unbound_placeholder_rule: {{name}} with no slot becomes {name}, the PR's grammar; the same rewrite applies to the placeholder inside an overridden job title

single_slot_template.why: A frozen candidate is one body; the built-in templates require several slots. Each case gets a user template (a published extension point) with the same direction, revision and limits as the built-in one, and only these slots.

valid-contact-from-profile.text: 您好，我是{{contact_name}}，希望了解岗位工作。

reject-mixed-contact-reference-and-liter.text: 邮箱：{{contact_email}}，另一个邮箱是 v23-alt@example.invalid。

error_categories.unfilled_placeholder: is not a placeholder|no profile entry with id|a job placeholder is|has no \w+$|模板标记没有替换
error_categories.fabricated_number: the number .* is not in what it cites

date_rendering: profile 2026-12-07 renders as 2026年12月7日 (material.md 7.1); the final-text check applies this one rewrite
